description: This file contains a test class ExportSchema used to generate a schema SQL script from JPA entity annotations. It extends an abstract test case, autowires an EntityManagerFactory bean, and defines a test method that executes schema creation via Hibernate's SchemaExport.

classes.name: ExportSchema
classes.description: A JUnit test class for exporting database schema from JPA annotated entities.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates a SQL schema script from JPA entities and Hibernate configuration. The method is annotated as a JUnit test and ignored by default.
